correctness.rationale: All 232, 159 and 72 nonempty simplices, all 720, 471 and 168 Hasse covers, and complete 111, 77, 33-pair acyclic Morse matchings were independently reconstructed. Finite enumeration is exhaustive over the 10-vertex case, not extrapolated.
